reader.requirement: At --std 85 a REWRITE statement on a relative file in sequential access mode must not carry INVALID KEY or NOT INVALID KEY (alone or together, with or without FROM), while random and dynamic REWRITE keep the phrases and their invalid key condition.

edition-consulted.switches: severity only (strict error, --permissive warning); reads Permissive, not the edition
Edition.Year < 2002: the 1985 mandatory INVALID KEY of SR4 (another rule) on the same statement

reader.witnesses-cover: part: the two witnesses cover INVALID KEY on relative sequential access and on sequential organization; NOT INVALID KEY alone, FROM, the default access mode and the legal random/dynamic arms are not exercised

probes.printed: COBOL1720 x3: NOT INVALID KEY on ACCESS SEQUENTIAL (line 25); INVALID+NOT INVALID with FROM on default access (line 29); INVALID KEY on default access with period scope (line 34) (exit 65); identical at --std 2023
probes.expected: every relative sequential-access REWRITE with either phrase refused (§1985:VIII.4.6.3 SR3)

probes.printed: R1=NIK 00 / R2=IK 23 / R3=IK 23 / R4 FS=00 / R5 FS=00 / X1=NEW1 Y1=YYYY
probes.expected: random and dynamic REWRITE with INVALID KEY compile and raise 23 on a missing record (GR13); sequential-access REWRITE without phrases after READ succeeds; the FROM data and the replaced record read back

reader.notes: KeyedIoBinder.BindRewrite screens either phrase family when Organization is Relative and AccessMode is Sequential (default included) through the COBOL1720 seam; no edition arm exists for this rule and none is needed, since the 1985 text matches the later one. Message cites the 2023 clause number only.
